verdict.rationale: Kling documents a first-party RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth and global and China endpoints. Its per-unit API pricing covers many core generation modes: text-to-video, image-to-video with start/end frames, video input, motion control, and audio. It also advertises an MCP/CLI for agent-driven use. Nothing documents that UI-only workflows are exposed programmatically, including the Agent brainstorming flow, Skills, node-based editing, Elements, multi-shot storyboarding and mask re-editing. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI feature-parity statement, API reference coverage of Agent/Skills/node workflows and editing features, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
